trends.name: OpenAI increases investment in product security
trends.summary: OpenAI has raised bug bounties and is preparing a new round of security sprints, increasing the intensity of investment in product security testing.
trends.attention_driver: High-value rewards and ongoing offensive and defensive activities make model and platform security a visible threshold in enterprise procurement.

evidence.quote: OpenAI is raising Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses
evidence.claim: Supports reports that OpenAI has raised bug bounties and added reward mechanisms.

evidence.quote: OpenAI is preparing its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses
evidence.claim: Supports reports that OpenAI continues to conduct targeted security strengthening tests.

evidence.quote: Bug hunters can now earn up to $172,000 from OpenAI as company ramps up security
evidence.claim: Independent reporting confirms that OpenAI has raised its maximum vulnerability reward and security investment.

trends.so_what: Include external vulnerability feedback, permission audits, and emergency fixes in the product release cycle, rather than relying only on pre-launch reviews. Enterprise-facing features need to clearly explain data boundaries and security response responsibilities.

trends.name: Siri opens third-party app actions
trends.summary: Apple reportedly allows Siri to perform actions in third-party apps and is testing continuous audio understanding on Apple Watch.
trends.attention_driver: A system-level assistant has gained an entry point for cross-app execution, making action confirmation and permission experiences competitive points for assistant products.

evidence.quote: Apple will now let Siri AI perform actions across third-party apps.
evidence.claim: Supports reporting that Siri has gained the ability to perform actions in third-party apps.

evidence.quote: Siri can tune into the Apple Watch's mic with Audio Intelligence features
evidence.claim: Supports reporting that Apple is integrating continuous audio capabilities into Siri.

evidence.quote: Apple Watch’s AI features for rewinding and recapping conversations begin beta testing
evidence.claim: Supports reports that the audio recap feature has entered testing.

trends.so_what: If a product relies on mobile task execution, it should design discoverable action interfaces, clear user confirmation, and reversible records in advance. Voice and ambient audio increase entry frequency, while also increasing accidental activation and privacy design costs.

trends.name: Frontier model companies face pressure on compute economics
trends.summary: Multiple reports focus on Anthropic's rapid revenue growth alongside widening losses, as well as its long-term compute contract commitments.
trends.attention_driver: High growth has not eliminated pressure from inference and infrastructure spending, and the market is paying closer attention to the economic return per task.

evidence.quote: Anthropic 季度营收增长十二倍至近 170 亿美元，但净亏损达 233 亿美元
evidence.claim: Supports reporting on Anthropic's revenue growth and widening losses.

evidence.quote: Anthropic's compute margins should be getting better, they’re getting worse.
evidence.claim: Supports market concerns about Anthropic's compute margins.

evidence.quote: 算力与基础设施合同承诺总额约 $895.4B，其中 $447.5B 须在 2031 年前支付
evidence.claim: Supports market discussion of Anthropic's long-term compute contract obligations.

trends.so_what: Product pricing should be tested against the cost of completing tasks and retention value, rather than expanding based only on call volume. Prepare model tiers, caching, and budget controls for high-frequency or long-chain agents to avoid worsening gross margins as scale grows.

watch_list.name: NVIDIA compute supply faces regional constraints
watch_list.summary: Reports say NVIDIA has asked some cloud customers to reduce their China business, while Rubin production hardware has begun shipping with updated specifications.
watch_list.attention_driver: Chip supply, regional allocation among cloud customers, and export restrictions are combining to increase capacity uncertainty for cross-region deployments.

evidence.quote: Nvidia has told some cloud customers to take on less business from Chinese companies.
evidence.claim: Supports reports that NVIDIA's cloud business faces China-related regional restrictions.

evidence.quote: As production hardware starts shipping, NVIDIA has updated some of the specifications for its Rubin GPU platforms
evidence.claim: Supports Rubin platform entering the production hardware shipment stage.

evidence.quote: Huawei is telling customers to source the high-performance memory for its AI chips on their own
evidence.claim: Supports continued procurement friction in the supply chain for high-performance AI hardware.

watch_list.so_what: Products involving multi-region inference should include regional availability, model fallback, and supplier switching in capacity plans. Do not treat a single GPU path or fixed regional pricing as a long-term assumption.

insights.text: Agent permission experience becomes a product threshold: as cross-app execution entry points increase, confirmation, revocation, and auditing need to become default interactions
Cost per task faces greater scrutiny: revenue growth has not eliminated compute spending, and long-chain agents must control call budgets
Voice entry points continue to expand: continuous audio understanding has entered testing, and live products need to plan for accidental activation and privacy boundaries

since_last: Real-task evaluations as a basis for product selection did not continue this issue.
